title: Optimal Partition Of String
description:
Partition string `s` into the fewest contiguous substrings such that no substring contains a repeated character. Return the minimum number of substrings.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "abacaba"
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: s = "ssssss"
Output: 6
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 10^5`
- `s` contains lowercase English letters.
